content.title: Where to watch 1st night of WrestleMania 2026 tonight on free streams, TV
content.text: Randy Orton addresses the WWE Universe during SmackDown at T-Mobile Arena on April 17, 2026 in Las Vegas, Nevada. (Photo by Craig Melvin/WWE via Getty Images)WWEIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Dustin Hockensmith | dhockensmith@pennlive.comThe superstars of WWE will take Las Vegas by storm for the first of a two-night WrestleMania 42 event and a full card of high-flying matches at Allegiant Stadium. The event is scheduled to start at 6 p.m. ET (3 p.m. PT) with TV coverage on ESPN Unlimited and streaming on-demand.WWE on ESPN Unlimited: The ESPN Unlimited platform is the new home of WWE premium events, including WrestleMania, SummerSlam, Royal Rumble, and more.ESPN Unlimited is a standalone streaming platform available for $29.99 per month or $299.99 for an annual plan. The service features access to all ESPN and ABC channels, as well as all content on ESPN+. ESPN Unlimited is also available through streaming services FuboTV (free trial) and DirecTV (free trial).How to watch WrestleMania 42 on TV and stream without cable:When: Saturday, April 19 at 6 p.m. ET (3 p.m. PT)Where: Allegiant Stadium, Las Vegas, Nev.TV channel: ESPN UnlimitedStreaming on: FuboTV (free trial) | DirecTV (free trial) | ESPN Unlimited ($29.99/mo.)WrestleMania 42: Saturday match cardLogan Paul, Austin Theory & IShowSpeed vs. The Usos & LA KnightJacob Fatu vs. Drew McIntyre (Unsanctioned Match)Women’s World Championship -- Stephanie Vaquer vs. Liv MorganWomen’s Intercontinental Championship -- AJ Lee (c) vs. Becky LynchWomen’s Tag Team Championship -- Nia Jax & Lash Legend (c) vs. Charlotte Flair & Alexa Bliss vs. Bayley & Lyra Valkyria vs. Nikki & Brie BellaSeth Rollins vs. GuntherUndisputed WWE Championship -- Cody Rhodes (c) vs. Randy OrtonWrestleMania 42: Know your live streamsFuboTV (free trial): FuboTV offers the most extensive package of live sports with rates competitive with DirecTV. The FuboTV Pro ($48.99 first month), Elite ($53.99) and Deluxe ($73.99) all come with first-month discounts. Fubo streaming plans include access to ESPN Unlimited.DirecTV (free trial): DirecTV offers a 5-day free trial and a total of $30 off over the first three full months for the Choice Package, which includes 125-plus channels and access to ESPN Unlimited, a $29.99 standalone value featuring all ESPN channels and ESPN+.ESPN Unlimited ($29.99 bundle): ESPN has a new, standalone package that includes ABC broadcasts, all of ESPN’s sports channels, and access to ESPN+. For a limited time, ESPN can be bundled with Disney Plus and Hulu for $29.99 per month. This package is included free in select FuboTV and DirecTV plans, along with other TV providers.
